messages:
anu: FYI caught another docs drift during office hours. The Python quickstart still documents `Client.from_env()` which we removed last sprint. New dev hit an AttributeError.

zoe: oi. any traceback?

anu: short one: `AttributeError: type object 'Client' has no attribute 'from_env'`. README code block shows:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client.from_env()
print(client.generate('hello'))
```

should be updated to the canonical pattern:

```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
print(client.generate('hello'))
```

tyler: thanks. i also noticed our Go quickstart doesn't document the retry helper and the curl examples in multiple pages are inconsistent: some use `$REDWOOD_KEY`, some `$REDWOOD_API_KEY`. We should standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across all snippets.

anu: i pushed a tiny PR that replaces deprecated constructors and env var names in the quickstart dir and added a short unit that parses the README and asserts the expected constructor string is present. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

zoe: can we add a quick CI guard that runs `scripts/check-snippets.sh` which greps for deprecated symbols like `from_env`, `REDWOOD_KEY`, `Client()` (legacy)? keep it cheap so it runs on docs PRs.

tyler: opened an issue to add a docs-only CI job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/92. Suggestion: a GitHub Actions job that runs on push to docs and executes the linter and snippet smoke tests in parallel.

ci-bot: docs PR 412: snippet-check passed, lint failed (trailing newline rules).

docs-bot: note: updated CONTRIBUTING.md with a short checklist item: "Run `scripts/check-snippets.sh` when changing SDK surface or auth patterns."

anu: assigning follow-ups: @zoe (merge once lint fixed), @tyler (add Go retry example), @anu (helm of the check script).

zoe: will fix lint and merge after green. thanks for the quick catch. :rocket:
